reading.zh: 个人中心里上传/手写保存预存签名并设定默认（profile、default），每次变更都留痕（audit）；审批时一键调用预存签名（picker），随后仍生成一条全新的签名记录。
reading.en: In the personal center the user uploads or draws preset signatures and sets a default (profile, default), every change is traced (audit); during approval one tap reuses a preset (picker) and still creates a brand-new signature record.
